items.title: “Every Run Is a Race Run” | Vital's B Practice Podcast - South Korea World Cup
items.description:
After a rough first race of the year, followed by some horrendous travel, it took us an extra week to nail down our guy Dak to podcast. We chatted a good bit about his race weekend in South Korea and how he’s feeling about his program going into the next big block of racing. We also discussed how he rushed to race the Monster Pro Downhill at Mountain Creek last weekend, and how he’s heading to Andorra next week to make his bike stiffer. Plus, all the usual race weekend coverage, including Asa winning his first try in Elites, Aletha having the fastest time of the day, track notes from a wild first-time venue, gripes with the broadcast, Amaury’s what could have been winning run, big names off the pace, new names in juniors, and a bunch of other nonsense. We hope you enjoy. Thanks for listening!

items.title: FOX starts off the 2026 Downhill World Cup Season in South Korea with Asa Vermette – The Setup | FOX
items.description:
Episode two of The Setup takes us to Pyeongchang, South Korea for the opening round of the UCI World Series. It’s been more than two decades since the last UCI Downhill World Cup was held in Asia, and with a brand-new venue featuring multiple lines and plenty of variety, riders will have their work cut out for them as they sort out the right setup for this amazingly unpredictable track.

After a long offseason, this week feels a bit like a family reunion. Remi catches up with the teams, athletes, and of course the FOX race crew as everyone settles back into race week. From suspension setup, track walk analysis and last-minute bike changes, the pits are full of constant fine-tuning. 

On a fresh track like this, the FOX team is fully locked in to make sure every detail is refine before race runs begin.

Host: Remi Gauvin
Video: Brooks Curran

items.title: Testing with Jackson Goldstone ahead of the 2026 DH World Cup - The Setup | FOX
items.description:
Welcome to The Setup, where FOX takes you inside the moments that matter before riders drop in. Hosted by Rémi Gauvin, and following FOX's World Cup Downhill athletes, each episode breaks down the decisions, adjustments, and teamwork that go into performing at the highest level.
 
From track walk, to practice laps to final tweaks, The Setup connects the dots between rider feedback, suspension performance, and race-day execution. With input from athletes, mechanics, and FOX Race department and engineers, you’ll see how World Cup teams push for perfect balance in the harshest conditions.
 
To kick things off, we caught up with Jackson Goldstone on one of Vancouver’s most iconic downhill training zones, Cypress Mountain on the North Shore, as he prepared for round one of the World Cup in South Korea.

New episodes drop ahead of World Cup DH finals.

Host: Remi Gauvin (https://www.instagram.com/remi.the.semi/)
Video: Brooks Curran (https://www.instagram.com/brookscurran/)

items.title: Santa Cruz Got Rid of VPP... Is the Tallboy 6 Still Great?
items.description:
The news broke a little early on this one, but the Santa Cruz Tallboy has been fully revised for 2026, and features a completely new silhouette for the 6th iteration of the platform. The move away from the typical VPP suspension layout is sure to generate debate, but there's a lot more to this bike than that one detail.

With more travel, slightly more stable geometry, and a lighter overall package, the idiosyncratic nature of the Tallboy remains, and still aims to be the short travel ripper that suits a certain type of rider.
